flags: Route 70 cache describes the Forest Service byway both as SR 149 to US 395 and as all SR 70. Overview follows the narrower explicit SR 149-to-US 395 description; material maps only 93.5 miles. Exact app corridor endpoints need editorial reconciliation.
The same cache calls portions a State Scenic Highway but also says eligible rather than designated by Caltrans. Only the consistently supported National Forest Scenic Byway designation is used.
No cached Forest Service or tourism-body rationale or driving time is available. Descriptive canyon, tunnel and railway evidence supplies the scenic character.
The historic year-round-road campaign is not a claim of current all-season access. Cache lacks current highway closure information; no practical status or checked-access claim is supplied.
Paxton’s zero population is tied to the 2020 census; omitted as peripheral, not converted into a current ghost-town claim.

Cherokee cache contains apparent cross-state contamination (Great Smoky Mountains and Mingo Falls); none of that material is used. Concow uses several Indigenous name forms without a community source; no unsupported terminology reconciliation is attempted.
